'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Chris Gogolen LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Long Day for you
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
